## Field definitions

- **Title** (`title`). Title UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Subtitle** (`subtitle`). Subtitle UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Album** (`album`). Album UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Grouping** (`grouping`). Grouping UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Version** (`version`). Version UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Original Title** (`original_title`). Original Title UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value. FLAC reads aliases `ORIGINALTITLE`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `ORIGINALTITLE`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `ORIGINALTITLE`.
- **Artist** (`artist`). Track artist credits in source order. UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Artist Display** (`artist_display`). Literal display credit for the track artist. UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Artists** (`artists`). Explicit ordered individual artists, independent of display credit. UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Album Artist** (`album_artist`). Album Artist UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value. FLAC reads aliases `ALBUM ARTIST`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `ALBUM ARTIST`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `ALBUM ARTIST`.
- **Album Artist Display** (`album_artist_display`). Album Artist Display UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Original Artist** (`original_artist`). Original Artist UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Performer** (`performer`). Performer UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Featured Artist** (`featured_artist`). Featured Artist UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Performer Credits** (`performer_credits`). Performer Credits Nonempty person name and role or instrument.
- **Composer** (`composer`). Composer UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Lyricist** (`lyricist`). Lyricist UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Conductor** (`conductor`). Conductor UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Arranger** (`arranger`). Arranger UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Work** (`work`). Work UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Movement** (`movement`). Movement UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Movement Number** (`movement_number`). Movement Number Nonnegative signed 64-bit integer. FLAC reads aliases `MOVEMENTNUMBER`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `MOVEMENTNUMBER`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `MOVEMENTNUMBER`.
- **Movement Total** (`movement_total`). Movement Total Nonnegative signed 64-bit integer.
- **Show Movement** (`show_movement`). Show Movement True or false.
- **Opus Number** (`opus_number`). Opus Number UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Producer** (`producer`). Producer UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Engineer** (`engineer`). Engineer UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Mixer** (`mixer`). Mixer UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Remixer** (`remixer`). Remixer UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Mastering Engineer** (`mastering_engineer`). Mastering Engineer UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Production Credits** (`production_credits`). Production Credits Nonempty person name and role or instrument.
- **Publisher** (`publisher`). Publisher UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Record Label** (`record_label`). Record Label UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Organization** (`organization`). Organization UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Catalog Number** (`catalog_number`). Catalog Number UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Track Number** (`track_number`). Track Number Nonnegative signed 64-bit integer.
- **Track Total** (`track_total`). Track Total Nonnegative signed 64-bit integer. FLAC reads aliases `TOTALTRACKS`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `TOTALTRACKS`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `TOTALTRACKS`.
- **Disc Number** (`disc_number`). Disc Number Nonnegative signed 64-bit integer.
- **Disc Total** (`disc_total`). Disc Total Nonnegative signed 64-bit integer. FLAC reads aliases `TOTALDISCS`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `TOTALDISCS`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `TOTALDISCS`.
- **Compilation** (`compilation`). Compilation True or false.
- **Media Type** (`media_type`). Media Type UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value. FLAC reads aliases `MEDIATYPE`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `MEDIATYPE`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `MEDIATYPE`.
- **Media Kind** (`media_kind`). Media Kind Nonnegative signed 64-bit integer.
- **Genre** (`genre`). Genre UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value. MP4 reads aliases `gnre`.
- **Mood** (`mood`). Mood UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **BPM** (`bpm`). BPM Nonnegative signed 64-bit integer. Unit `beats/minute`.
- **Musical Key** (`musical_key`). Musical Key UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value. FLAC reads aliases `KEY`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `KEY`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `KEY`.
- **Language** (`language`). Language UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Recording Date** (`recording_date`). When the audio was recorded. Calendar-valid ISO year, month, date or timestamp at supplied precision. FLAC reads aliases `RECORDINGDATE`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `RECORDINGDATE`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `RECORDINGDATE`.
- **Release Date** (`release_date`). Release date of the specific edition. Calendar-valid ISO year, month, date or timestamp at supplied precision.
- **Original Release Date** (`original_release_date`). Original release date of the work or recording. Calendar-valid ISO year, month, date or timestamp at supplied precision. FLAC reads aliases `ORIGINALYEAR`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `ORIGINALYEAR`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `ORIGINALYEAR`.
- **Encoding Date** (`encoding_date`). Encoding Date Calendar-valid ISO year, month, date or timestamp at supplied precision.
- **Tagging Date** (`tagging_date`). Tagging Date Calendar-valid ISO year, month, date or timestamp at supplied precision.
- **Copyright** (`copyright`). Copyright UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value. MP4 reads aliases `©cpy`.
- **License** (`license`). License UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value.
- **Ownership** (`ownership`). Ownership UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value. FLAC reads aliases `OWNERSHIP`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `OWNERSHIP`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `OWNERSHIP`.
- **Payment URL** (`payment_url`). Payment URL Absolute URI with scheme; HTTP and HTTPS require a host.
- **Terms Of Use** (`terms_of_use`). Terms Of Use UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value. FLAC reads aliases `TERMSOFUSE`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `TERMSOFUSE`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `TERMSOFUSE`.
- **ISRC** (`isrc`). ISRC ISO 3901 identifier in 12-character compact form.
- **UPC** (`upc`). UPC 12 decimal digits.
- **Barcode** (`barcode`). Barcode 8, 12, 13 or 14 decimal digits.
- **ASIN** (`asin`). ASIN 10 uppercase letters or digits.
- **MusicBrainz Recording ID** (`musicbrainz_recording_id`). MusicBrainz recording identifier; historically called Track Id. Hyphenated hexadecimal UUID.
- **MusicBrainz Release Track ID** (`musicbrainz_release_track_id`). MusicBrainz track identifier within a release. Hyphenated hexadecimal UUID.
- **MusicBrainz Release ID** (`musicbrainz_release_id`). MusicBrainz Release ID Hyphenated hexadecimal UUID.
- **MusicBrainz Release Group ID** (`musicbrainz_release_group_id`). MusicBrainz Release Group ID Hyphenated hexadecimal UUID.
- **MusicBrainz Artist ID** (`musicbrainz_artist_id`). MusicBrainz Artist ID Hyphenated hexadecimal UUID.

- **Synchronized Lyrics** (`synchronized_lyrics`). Synchronized Lyrics Language, description, and ordered millisecond lyric cues.

- **Timed Metadata** (`timed_metadata`). Timed Metadata Millisecond start, content type and opaque nonempty bytes.

- **Podcast Show** (`podcast_show`). Podcast Show UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value. FLAC reads aliases `PODCASTSHOW`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `PODCASTSHOW`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `PODCASTSHOW`.
- **Podcast Episode** (`podcast_episode`). Podcast Episode Nonnegative signed 64-bit integer. FLAC reads aliases `PODCASTEPISODE`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `PODCASTEPISODE`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `PODCASTEPISODE`.
- **Podcast Season** (`podcast_season`). Podcast Season Nonnegative signed 64-bit integer. FLAC reads aliases `PODCASTSEASON`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `PODCASTSEASON`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `PODCASTSEASON`.
- **Podcast Category** (`podcast_category`). Podcast Category UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value. FLAC reads aliases `PODCASTCATEGORY`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `PODCASTCATEGORY`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `PODCASTCATEGORY`.
- **Podcast Feed URL** (`podcast_feed_url`). Podcast Feed URL Absolute URI with scheme; HTTP and HTTPS require a host. FLAC reads aliases `PODCASTURL`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `PODCASTURL`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `PODCASTURL`.
- **Podcast Episode ID** (`podcast_episode_id`). Podcast Episode ID UTF-8 without U+0000; an empty string is a value. FLAC reads aliases `PODCASTID`. Ogg Vorbis reads aliases `PODCASTID`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `PODCASTID`.
- **Artwork** (`artwork`). Artwork Picture role 0–20, MIME type or linked image marker, and original bytes.
- **Replaygain Track Gain** (`replaygain_track_gain`). Replaygain Track Gain Finite 64-bit decimal value. Unit `dB`. MP4 reads aliases `----:com.apple.iTunes:replaygain_track_gain`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `REPLAYGAIN_TRACK_GAIN`.
- **Replaygain Album Gain** (`replaygain_album_gain`). Replaygain Album Gain Finite 64-bit decimal value. Unit `dB`. MP4 reads aliases `----:com.apple.iTunes:replaygain_album_gain`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `REPLAYGAIN_ALBUM_GAIN`.
- **Replaygain Track Peak** (`replaygain_track_peak`). Replaygain Track Peak Nonnegative finite decimal; may exceed 1. Unit `linear amplitude ratio`. MP4 reads aliases `----:com.apple.iTunes:replaygain_track_peak`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `REPLAYGAIN_TRACK_PEAK`.
- **Replaygain Album Peak** (`replaygain_album_peak`). Replaygain Album Peak Nonnegative finite decimal; may exceed 1. Unit `linear amplitude ratio`. MP4 reads aliases `----:com.apple.iTunes:replaygain_album_peak`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `REPLAYGAIN_ALBUM_PEAK`.
- **Replaygain Reference Loudness** (`replaygain_reference_loudness`). Replaygain Reference Loudness Finite 64-bit decimal value. Unit `dB SPL`. MP4 reads aliases `----:com.apple.iTunes:replaygain_reference_loudness`. Ogg Opus reads aliases `REPLAYGAIN_REFERENCE_LOUDNESS`.

- **R128 Album Gain** (`r128_album_gain`). R128 Album Gain Integer from −32768 through 32767 inclusive, relative to OpusHead output gain. Unit `signed Q7.8 dB`.
- **Integrated Loudness** (`integrated_loudness`). Integrated Loudness Finite 64-bit decimal value. Unit `LUFS`.
- **Loudness Range** (`loudness_range`). Loudness Range Nonnegative finite decimal. Unit `LU`.
- **Rating** (`rating`). User rating on a 0–100 scale Integer from 0 through 100 inclusive. Unit `percent`.

- **Gapless Album** (`gapless_album`). Album-level gapless playback preference. True or false.
